people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.
translations.bsb: There we found some brothers who invited us to spend the week with them. And so we came to Rome.
translations.kjv: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
